marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the LVS assembly GCA_000009245.1 (AM233362.1) by in silico
# PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every marker gave exactly one product.
# The primers are used exactly as published, each carrying a non-genomic 5' G; removing that base from
# both primers of a pair clears all primer mismatches and shortens every product by 2 bp, so ref_size is
# only valid for the primers as written here.
# unit_length, ref_repeats and patterns are still empty: Table S1 gives no repeat units, copy numbers or
# product sizes, so no allele can be called yet. Take the unit lengths and consensus repeats from
# Johansson et al. 2004 (doi:10.1128/JB.186.17.5808-5818.2004), which defines these loci, or derive them
# with mlvatyper discover on a reference run; ref_repeats must then be counted in the LVS amplicons so
# that it is consistent with the ref_size above.
